items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: It's Billy, but it's not Didi.

ctx.x: . Know this number. You know who that is? It's Billy, but it's not Didi. You know who that is? You know who that is? How did you like that? It sounded good. I knew that, I could tell that. Did anybody else play like that on that auto run there? No. Only Billy. How about let me get another one, cued up on the same record. Okay. How about picking all of them, one of the two?
Billy played with the bands too that came to town then.
